messages:
maria_support: FYI — P1 from ACME. They hit repeated 500s on /v1/generate and claim a debug bundle included raw customer PII. Customer provided two request IDs: req_8a1b2c3d and req_8a1b2c4e. Also reporting higher-than-expected token billing for the last hour. Need repro steps, a sanitized debug bundle, and confirmation we did not leak secrets. Do NOT paste raw bundle in public channels.

jason_oncall: Ack. Can you paste a minimal curl reproducer (sanitized) and a small snippet of the error response here? Also tell us which model and region. We'll need the full debug bundle but uploaded to the secure artifact store only.

maria_support: Minimal curl (sanitized) below — note I replaced auth token and removed customer names. The response body included fields that look like names/emails in the model output.
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: req_8a1b2c3d" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-1","input":"<customer prompt>...","max_tokens":512}'
```

Response snippet (sanitized):
```json
{"error":"internal_server_error","details":"stack trace... user_email: [REDACTED] user_phone: [REDACTED]"}
```

sophie_privsec: Thanks — we need to coordinate redaction before anything leaves the customer account area. Do not upload the raw bundle to Slack or public S3. Steps to produce a sanitized bundle: 1) grep for the request IDs, 2) run the internal redaction helper (/opt/tools/redact_debug.sh) which replaces emails/phones/SSNs/cc numbers and base64 blobs, 3) run the validation pass which ensures no 16+ digit sequences remain. If the script fails, create an encrypted artifact and share the KMS key with Security only.

li_devex: Add these repro items to the bundle so eng can reproduce: exact endpoint, full headers (with tokens redacted), model name, payload size, number of input tokens, and a tiny sanitized prompt that still triggers the error. Example small prompt we can use to repro: "summarize: <sanitized excerpt>". Also include the curl with --data-binary and the X-Debug-Trace header to capture service-side traces.

kevin_eng: To triage the 500s and latency we need full traces and the top-of-host logs (dmesg/syslog) around the timestamps. Also include the X-Request-ID for each failing call. When replaying, please include this header: -H 'X-Debug-Trace: 1' so our runtime emits request-level spans. From the initial look, the stack hints at a memory pressure path in the KV cache code.

maria_support: I created a sanitized bundle and uploaded to the secure bucket (s3://redwood-internal/acme/p1/redacted_bundle_1759994321.tar.gpg). I confirmed the redaction script replaced emails and phone numbers. Request IDs included: req_8a1b2c3d, req_8a1b2c4e, req_8a1b3d9f. Customer also asked if billing spikes were caused by retries.

jason_oncall: I pulled the redacted bundle and will start replaying the requests on staging. If we need to escalate to a hotfix, we'll aim for a targeted change in the next ~3 hours. @kevin_eng please collect a perf profile during replay and watch memory / GPU allocation graphs.

sophie_privsec: Quick redaction checklist I ran against the bundle: 1) emails: egrep -n "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}" -> replaced, 2) phones: egrep -n "(\+?\d{1,3}[ -]?)?\(?\d{3}\)?[ -]?\d{3}[ -]?\d{4}" -> replaced, 3) SSN-ish: egrep -n "\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b" -> replaced, 4) credit-card patterns: luhn check run, masked. If you used custom regexes or embeddings, note them in the bundle metadata.

li_devex: For folks trying to reproduce locally, here is a docker-based repro runner (sanitized):
```bash
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED -v $(pwd)/sanitized:/repro redwood/repro-runner:latest \n  --endpoint https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  --header 'X-Request-ID:req_8a1b2c3d' \
  --payload ./sanitized/payload.json
```
Include a small prompt file that still triggers the error so we don't need customer PII.

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-ACME-1257 · Priority: P1 · Owner: jason_oncall · Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0317-ACME-1257

deploy-bot: Note: no deploys in the last 2 hours to the affected service.

kevin_eng: Quick update after an initial replay: reproduces on staging. Traces show a burst of KV cache evictions when a large batch arrives combined with a long-tail tokenization path. Hypothesis: default batching window + cold model loads cause temporary OOMs -> 500s. Mitigation attempt: reduce max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 512 on the staging pool and re-run.

maria_support: ACME confirmed they received the redacted bundle and accepted the temporary repro steps for us to run. They want an ETA for mitigation and confirmation that no customer secrets were exposed.

jason_oncall: ETA for mitigation + follow-up note to customer: 2-4 hours. We'll keep them updated every 30 minutes. I'll post a summary and the billing analysis once we validate replay results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sophie_privsec: Once mitigation is in place, I'll coordinate a short audit and produce a redaction report to send to the customer: what was redacted, why, and proof the artifact contains no PII. Do not send raw logs in email. Use secure ticket attachments only.

kevin_eng: If mitigation looks good on staging I'll promote the batch window change to canary with rollback policy. Will attach the perf graphs and the trace snippets to the incident.

maria_support: Thanks team — I'll update the customer channel and share this thread with them (sanitized) after we confirm. If anyone needs the original encrypted bundle, contact Security for the KMS key.
